narrative.details:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
narrative.objectives: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
narrative.requestItemsText: If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
